def factor_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday_norm120(df):
    """Cycle phase from exponentially weighted overnight-intraday split, normalized by 120-day total absolute move."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    span = 60
    window_norm = 120
    overnight_ewm_sum = overnight_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    intraday_ewm_sum = intraday_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    numerator = overnight_ewm_sum - intraday_ewm_sum
    denom = (overnight_ret.abs().rolling(window_norm, min_periods=1).sum() + intraday_ret.abs().rolling(window_norm, min_periods=1).sum()).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    factor = (numerator / denom).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday_norm120"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday_norm120"]
